title: A Phase 2 Trial of Hydroxychloroquine in Individuals at Risk for Rheumatoid Arthritis
observations_or_assays: Participant-reported painful-joint count over the full 42-joint assessment
time_scope: The primary month-36 endpoint; baseline/month-36 observed-data summaries for painful-joint counts.
excluded: Week-52, LOCF painful-joint variants, 32-joint and positive-count-only subsets
Alternate intercurrent-event/per-protocol policies, risk-factor subgroups, stiff joints, other symptoms and safety
population_or_material: The modified ITT population at risk for RA with elevated anti-CCP3 in StopRA.
requested_items: Month-36 RA/IA arm event counts and KM risk estimates/differences; full 42-joint painful-joint observed baseline/month-36 medians and differences. Exclude month-12 IA, diagnostic subdivisions and the subset that did not develop RA.
